system.description:
• Personally tutored by a single master wizard rather than enrolled in any institution — the deep one-to-one relationship produces a different kind of precision. No lecture hall, no cohort, just a master's direct attention and very high expectations.
  • Steady Hand: Advantage on saves against your own spells' backlash or unintended effects. Once per encounter, you may reroll a failed Fortitude save to keep a spell when damaged while casting.
  • Myllnoris Standing: Advantage on checks navigating Myllnoris's arcane bureaucracy or identifying Myllnoris-made magic items.
